8.name: Impossible Ancient Structures
8.overview: All over the world stand ancient structures so massive, precise, and baffling that they seem impossible for not just their time, but ours as well. From colossal walls and giant stone tombs to temples carved from solid rock, how did ancient civilizations achieve feats of engineering that still defy modern understanding?

8.name: Nightmares and Dreams
8.overview: Dreams have inspired humanity for thousands of years and in all this time, we have yet to answer one fundamental question: What is the purpose of dreams? From nightmares linked to unexplained deaths and more.

8.name: Unnatural Disasters
8.overview: Throughout history, catastrophic disasters have reshaped civilizations -- yet some events defy all scientific expectations.

8.name: Mysteries of Africa
8.overview: Africa remains one of the most mysterious continents on Earth. From lost cities buried beneath shifting sands, to the elusive tomb of history's most mighty queen, what secrets lie hidden throughout Africa's vast landscape?

8.name: Mind Over Matter
8.overview: The human mind is home to all our thoughts, hopes, dreams, and memories.

8.name: Mighty Kingdoms Unearthed
8.overview: An exploration of strange and inexplicable mysteries; contributions from scientists, historians and witnesses as they seek to shed light on how the impossible can happen.

8.name: Dangerous Places
8.overview: Every year, people risk their lives to enter places the world has marked off-limits. What is it about the world’s most dangerous places that makes them impossible to resist?

8.name: Satan's Army
8.overview: From demonic possession and cursed homes to battlefield apparitions and ancient pacts with the Devil, history is filled with chilling accounts of supernatural forces said to be working against humanity. Are these terrifying encounters simply the product of fear and belief… or could they point to a hidden war between good and evil-one that continues to this day?

8.name: Top Secret Projects
8.overview: Throughout history, governments have carried out top secret projects that defy belief-from experimental aircraft and staged illusions to covert experiments that crossed ethical boundaries. Hidden from the public and revealed only years later, these operations raise a chilling question: if these programs were real… what else might still be happening in secret today?

8.name: Mystery Of The Dinosaurs
8.overview:
Dinosaurs have fascinated scientists for nearly two centuries, and in all that time, we have yet to answer even the most basic questions about how these animals lived, how they died, and what became of them. From an extinction event whose cause scientists to actively debate, to ancient dragon legends some researchers trace directly to fossil discoveries, to genetic technologies now being used to bring extinct creatures back to life.

Content expanded.

8.name: The Lost World of the Aztecs
8.overview: Five centuries after the fall of the Aztec Empire, new discoveries are revealing that this lost civilization may have been far more sophisticated-and far stranger-than history has long suggested.

8.name: Objects of Power
8.overview: For centuries, certain objects have been deemed to heal the sick, summon spirits, legitimize kings, curse their owners, and even alter the fate of nations.

8.name: Unnerving Nature
8.overview: Across the planet are places where nature behaves in ways that seem to defy explanation. Forests where people vanish, deserts where signals fail, caves filled with toxic air and mountains no one dares to climb.

8.name: Deadly Ancient Curses
8.overview: Throughout history, people have feared that ancient curses can bring misfortune, madness, and even death to those who defy them.

8.name: Alien Close Encounters
8.overview: An exploration of strange and inexplicable mysteries. Contributions from scientists, historians and witnesses as they seek to shed light on how the impossible can happen.

8.name: Secrets of the Pyramids
8.overview: Why did so many ancient people, separated by oceans and centuries, return to the same monumental shape? Were pyramids simply the most practical way to build toward the sky--or could they reveal a deeper pattern of sacred knowledge?

8.name: Buried Mysteries
8.overview: Across the deserts of North Africa and the Near East--the region often called one of the Cradles of Civilization--entire armies, cities, and cultures have vanished beneath shifting sands.

8.name: Human Anomalies
8.overview: Across the world, rare medical disorders and extraordinary capabilities reveal how little we truly understand about the human body. Are these evidence that the human body is capable of far stranger things than science has fully explained?
